name: BioOnto Lab
tagline: Biomedical Ontology & Digital Health Informatics Lab
description: BioOnto Lab connects biomedical ontology, digital health, and population health research to build practical, data-informed solutions for communities.
aboutDescription: BioOnto Lab brings together researchers, students, and collaborators to develop trustworthy health data, ontologies, and digital tools for digital and population health.

focusAreas.title: Biomedical Ontology
focusAreas.description: Knowledge representation, formal ontologies, and semantic web technologies for health research.

focusAreas.title: Digital Health

focusAreas.title: Public Health and Epidemiological Informatics
